title: Relay

fields.label: Purpose
fields.value: Allows a signal to pass if another signal activates it

body:
"When the right input is higher than 0.0, the output will be the left input value."

The Relay is a logic component that can be purchased from Alan's AutoLogistics. It outputs one input signal when the other input is enabled.

Functionality

The Relay is used to activate to send one signal ONLY when both inputs have a signal. By using a number interface (Num Int) a relay can be solely used to change signal strength. This means that you can use signals other than 0 and 10.

On the side with two ports, the left input is used as the signal that will be passed through the relay. The right input is used to activate the left input's signal’s output.
